title: Meta, Microsoft, Amazon Q2 earnings preview: What hyperscaler investors expect
excerpt: Spending-conscious investors have been hard to impress lately, and it's ramped up the stakes ahead of earnings.
content_html:
We enter the heart of Big Tech earnings season at a precarious time for the AI trade.

Shares of chipmakers have gotten absolutely housed in recent days after leading the market for most of 2026. Hyperscalers haven't had a great run either, badly lagging the broader tech sector year to date.

But the primary dynamic that will define earnings season is investors' heightened sensitivity to capex spending. They're sick of companies pledging additional tens of billions of dollars towards AI development. They want tangible results, and soon.

That brings us to the main event(s): Meta and Microsoft earnings today after the market close, and Amazon reporting Thursday afternoon. Call it the Hyperscaler Super Bowl.

If the investor reaction to Alphabet and Tesla earnings last week is any indication, any increase in capital-spending plans will likely be met with swift stock selling. It's a dynamic that stretches back to last earnings season, when Meta and Microsoft found out the hard way that traders are growing weary of capex.

So assuming that investors will continue to punish spending this quarter, the question becomes: what does Wall Street need to hear to justify — or at least partially offset — that pressure?

Here are the answers for each of the three hyperscalers set to report over the next two days:

Meta

Meta is unique within the AI trade because it's not trying to monetize cloud computing. The company's AI opportunity instead lies in making its existing businesses more valuable. It's also a cash machine, which has historically earned it more investor patience when it comes to spending.

What investors want to see: That AI is producing measurable improvements in the advertising business. That could mean stronger ad pricing, higher user engagement, better advertiser conversion, or evidence that AI recommendations are boosting marketers' ROI.

Microsoft

Microsoft has the clearest AI-monetization story of the group. The company's massive AI investments are flowing directly into Azure, Copilot, and other enterprise offerings. The question isn't whether demand exists. It's whether that demand is strong enough to justify another wave of spending.

What investors want to see: That AI demand remains stronger than supply. That could mean accelerating Azure growth, surging AI-related bookings, expanding backlog, or commentary that capacity constraints — not weak demand — are what's limiting growth.

Amazon

While Amazon's AI investments span the entire firm, investors have historically been most interested in AWS as the primary company bellwether.

What investors want to see: That AWS is entering another phase of acceleration. That could mean faster cloud growth, strong AI workload demand, a growing backlog, or signs of strong customer spending.

All of these best-case scenarios are, of course, easier said than done. The bar has been set incredibly high for these high-flying AI names.

But sometimes the best defense is a good offense. Right now, the surest way for Meta, Microsoft, and Amazon to overcome skepticism is to overwhelm investors with proof that AI is paying off.

content_html_zh:
我们在人工智能行业正处于不稳定时期进入了大型科技财报季的核心。

芯片制造商的股价在 2026 年的大部分时间里引领市场后，最近几天已经完全稳定。 超大规模企业的表现也不佳，今年迄今为止严重落后于更广泛的科技行业。

但决定财报季的主要动力是投资者对资本支出的敏感性提高。 他们厌倦了公司承诺额外投入数百亿美元用于人工智能开发。 他们想要切实的成果，而且要尽快。

这给我们带来了主要事件：Meta 和微软今天收盘后公布财报，亚马逊周四下午公布财报。 称之为“超大规模超级碗”。

如果投资者上周对 Alphabet 和特斯拉财报的反应有任何迹象的话，那么资本支出计划的任何增加都可能会导致股票迅速抛售。 这种动态可以追溯到上个财报季，当时 Meta 和微软艰难地发现交易员对资本支出越来越厌倦。

因此，假设投资者将继续惩罚本季度的支出，问题就变成了：华尔街需要听到什么来证明——或至少部分抵消——这种压力的合理性？

以下是未来两天将报告的三个超大规模提供商的答案：

Meta

Meta 在人工智能行业中是独一无二的，因为它并不试图将云计算货币化。 相反，该公司的人工智能机会在于使其现有业务变得更有价值。 它也是一台提款机，历来为投资者在支出方面赢得了更多耐心。

投资者希望看到的是：人工智能正在为广告业务带来可衡量的改进。 这可能意味着更强大的广告定价、更高的用户参与度、更好的广告商转化率，或者有证据表明人工智能推荐正在提高营销人员的投资回报率。

微软

微软拥有该集团中最清晰的人工智能货币化故事。 该公司的大量人工智能投资直接流入 Azure、Copilot 和其他企业产品。 问题不在于需求是否存在。 问题在于这种需求是否足够强劲，足以证明另一波支出是合理的。

投资者希望看到的是：人工智能需求仍然强于供给。 这可能意味着Azure增长加速、人工智能相关预订量激增、积压订单扩大，或者评论称限制增长的是容量限制（而不是需求疲软）。

亚马逊

虽然亚马逊的人工智能投资遍布整个公司，但投资者历来对作为公司主要领头羊的 AWS 最感兴趣。

投资者希望看到的是：AWS 正在进入另一个加速阶段。 这可能意味着更快的云增长、强劲的人工智能工作负载需求、不断增加的积压或强劲的客户支出迹象。

当然，所有这些最佳情况都是说起来容易做起来难。 对于这些雄心勃勃的人工智能名字来说，门槛非常高。

但有时最好的防守就是良好的进攻。 目前，Meta、微软和亚马逊克服怀疑的最可靠方法是用人工智能正在带来回报的证据来压倒投资者。
